package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_collection_iteration_copy_slice_before_readonly_range: Layer: Collection iteration. Flag copying slices immediately before readonly iteration.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario519Positive(items []int) int {
	clone := append([]int(nil), items...)
	total := 0
	for _, v := range clone {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}
